info.name: Feedback
info.description:
User feedback and bug report endpoints for Rent Room.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}

Submitting feedback requires any valid JWT.
Viewing feedback requires ADMIN role.

When feedback is submitted, the admin receives a Telegram notification.

request.description:
Submits a feedback report. Admin is notified via Telegram after submission.

Rate limit: 3 per hour.

type: BUG | SUGGESTION | OTHER

Errors:
- 400: Missing or invalid fields
- 429: Rate limit exceeded

Returns all submitted feedback ordered by newest first. Includes the submitting user's id, name, and email.

Role: ADMIN only.

response.name: 200 OK
